techniques.name: Shot-Chart CNN Embeddings + PCA Reduction
techniques.implementation: Extract 48x48 spatial heatmaps from shot logs → CNN encoder → 128-dim embeddings → PCA k=20 (92.7% variance retention). Integrates with existing features.
techniques.notes: Directly responsible for Montrucchio's Brier 0.199. Captures spatial court usage patterns tree models cannot.

Build 48x48 grid discretization of half-court

PCA reduce to k=20 components

techniques.name: Monte Carlo Dropout for Calibrated Uncertainty
techniques.implementation: Apply Bayesian dropout at inference time: sample T forward passes through TabICL with dropout enabled, average predictions. Expected Calibration Error improves significantly.
techniques.notes: Works with TabICL. Provides probabilistic estimates + uncertainty quantification. Can post-process raw TabICL outputs.
action_items: Wrap TabICL forward pass in loop (T=20-50 samples)
Enable dropout during inference (non-standard)
Aggregate predictions via mean/variance
Measure calibration improvement via ECE/MCE metrics
Use variance as confidence weighting in Kelly

techniques.name: Rolling 5-Game Window Feature Engineering
techniques.implementation: Replace static season stats with rolling aggregates: 5-game win%, FG%, 3P%, assists/turnover, def rating. Prevents lookahead bias + captures momentum.
techniques.notes: Montrucchio uses 5-game windows to capture short-term form without information leakage. Already partially deployed (Cat39-43 include some rolling), expand systematically.
action_items: Audit current features for lookahead bias
Convert season stats to rolling windows: 5/10/20 games
Create rolling version of all counting stats
Test which window length works best (5 vs 10)
Deploy to all 6 HF islands as Cat47

techniques.name: Temporal Train-Val-Test Split (Chronological)
techniques.implementation: Enforce strict time ordering: train ≤2022, val 2023, test 2024. No shuffling, no future data leakage. Measure walk-forward performance with rolling windows.
techniques.notes: YOUR CURRENT ISSUE: walk-forward averaging 0.22447 suggests possible overfitting in Colab test. Montrucchio enforces this strictly.

techniques.name: TabICLv2 Repeated Feature Grouping
techniques.implementation: Use TabICLv2 (Feb 2026 release) instead of v1. Group correlated features into single tokens (not independent embeddings). Reduces representation collapse.
techniques.notes: TabICLv2 has better synthetic pretraining + hierarchical classification for >10 classes. Your 43 categories may benefit.
action_items: Upgrade to TabICLv2 on Colab
Implement feature grouping: group similar categories (e.g., all offensive efficiency features) into single tokens
Test hierarchical classification mode

techniques.name: Per-100-Possession Era Normalization
techniques.implementation: Normalize all rate stats (PPG, APG, TPG) to per-100-possessions basis. Adjust by era: divide season stats by league median for that year.
techniques.notes: Accounts for league-wide style evolution. 2012 ≠ 2026 pace/scoring. Montrucchio uses this explicitly for calibration.
action_items: Compute league median pace/scoring by season
Normalize all counting stats to per-100-possession basis
Calculate era adjustment factor (year-wise)
Apply in feature engine before model input
Measure impact on calibration (ECE)

techniques.name: Venn-Abers Calibration Post-Processing
techniques.implementation: Apply isotonic regression or Venn-Abers on calibration set to map raw predictions → calibrated probabilities. Guaranteed marginal calibration in finite samples.
techniques.notes: 2025 paper on conformal prediction + calibration. Works post-hoc on any model (TabICL, ensemble, etc.). Replaces sigmoid calibration.
action_items: Holdout calibration set (10% of validation data)
Fit isotonic regression: raw pred → target on calibration set
Apply isotonic map to all test predictions
Measure calibration metrics: ECE, MCE, Brier
Compare with current sigmoid calibration

techniques.name: Conformal Prediction for Uncertainty Sets
techniques.implementation: Generate prediction intervals/sets instead of point predictions. Use quantile conformal prediction for coverage guarantees. Integrate with Kelly sizing.
techniques.notes: Advanced: transforms point predictions into sets with proven coverage. Useful for risk-aware Kelly criterion. Low ROI vs effort.
action_items: Study conformal prediction theory (Barber et al.)
Implement quantile CP on calibration set
Generate prediction sets at 80/90% coverage levels
Integrate with fractional Kelly for conservative sizing
Measure ROI improvement on test set

techniques.name: Ensemble: TabICL + Tree Models (XGBoost/CatBoost)
techniques.implementation: Train TabICL (neural) + XGBoost (tree) independently on same features. Ensemble via weighted average: w*TabICL + (1-w)*XGBoost. Learn weights on validation set.
techniques.notes: Nature 2025 finds stacking hurts, but weighted ensemble works. TabICL captures nonlinearity, XGBoost captures feature interactions.
action_items: Train TabICL on full data (Colab GPU)
Train XGBoost on same data (CPU)
Holdout validation set to learn ensemble weights
Grid search weights w ∈ [0, 1]
Measure ensemble Brier vs single models

techniques.name: Genetic Algorithm with Parsimony Pressure
techniques.implementation: Add parsimony term to fitness: f = brier - λ * n_features. Penalize feature count. Evolve toward sweet spot (~60-80 features, not 200).
techniques.notes: Your islands use 55-80 features already, but S11 uses 80. GA with parsimony can auto-optimize feature count.
action_items: Add parsimony coefficient: f = brier + 0.01 * n_features
Measure Brier vs feature bloat trade-off

Deploy on S11 (exploration island) first

techniques.name: Synthetic Data Augmentation via TVAE
techniques.implementation: Train Temporal VAE on historical game data. Generate synthetic game scenarios. Augment training set. Retrain model on synthetic+real data.
techniques.notes: Helps with small sample sizes. NBA has ~82*30/2 = 1,230 games/season, which is small for deep learning. Low priority.

techniques.name: Kelly Criterion with Uncertainty Weighting
techniques.implementation: Use variance from MC dropout as confidence. Scale Kelly fraction: fraction = base_kelly * exp(-variance). Lower confidence → smaller bets.
techniques.notes: Doesn't improve Brier, but improves ROI by reducing edge cases. Complements MC dropout.
action_items: Compute variance from MC dropout samples
Scale Kelly fraction by confidence: f *= exp(-α*var), α ∈ [0.1, 1.0]
Backtest on 2024-25 odds
Compare ROI vs base Kelly (0.25-0.50 fractions)
Monitor Sharpe ratio improvement

techniques.implementation: Build graph: nodes=teams, edges=recent head-to-head results. GraphRNN processes interactions. Output: team embedding (100-dim). Add to features.
techniques.notes: Captures 'who you play affects how you play' effect. Very advanced. May not generalize to Colab GPU time constraints.
